name: What kind of structural assessment is needed before adding a second story?

mainEntity.name: What kind of structural assessment is needed before adding a second story?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before commencing a second-story addition, a thorough structural assessment of your existing foundation and framing is critical. This involves evaluating whether the current structure can safely support the additional weight of a new level. Our design-build team works with qualified engineers to determine if modifications, such as reinforcing foundations or adding new bearing walls, are necessary. This initial assessment ensures the safety and long-term stability of your customized renovation, aligning with our commitment to reliability and craftsmanship from the ground up.
acceptedAnswer.description: A structural assessment determines if your foundation and framing can support a second story, often requiring engineering to ensure safety and stability.
